title: Excise Duty on Minerals Labour Welfare Amendment Ordinance 1979

sections.shortTitle: Excise Duty on Minerals Labour Welfare Amendment Ordinance 1979
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXVIII OF 1979
ORDINANCE XXVIII OF 1979
EXCISE DUTY ON MINERALS (LABOUR WELFARE) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance to amend the Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) Act,
1967
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 7, 19th June 1979]
No. F. 17 (1)/79JPub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-.
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Excise Duty on Minerals Labour Welfare Amendment Ordinance 1979
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3, Act VIII of 1967

ORDINANCE XXVIII OF 1979
ORDINANCE XXVIII OF 1979
EXCISE DUTY ON MINERALS (LABOUR WELFARE) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance to amend the Excise Duty on Minerals (Labour Welfare) Act,
1967
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 7, 19th June 1979]
No. F. 17 (1)/79JPub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-.
2. Amendment of section 3, Act VIII of 1967.-In the Excise Duty on
Minerals (Labour Welfare) Act, 1967 (VIII of 1967), in section 3, in sub section
(1), for the words "fifty paisa" the words "one rupee" and
for the words "one rupee" the words "five rupees" shall be
substituted.
